app.title: Comink
app.subtitle: A real-time social network for students and small communities
app.description: A small social platform focused on real-time messaging and high-quality voice / video calls.
app.backend_offline: Cannot reach the backend (run dotnet run in /backend/src/Comink.Api)
app.feature_identity_desc: Registration, two-token JWT authentication, session security and student profiles.
app.feature_social_desc: Friends, following, posts with images, comments and reactions.
app.feature_messaging_desc: 1-1 and group chat over SignalR, message history with cursor pagination.
app.feature_calls_desc: High-quality calls powered by LiveKit WebRTC with a TURN server.
